addon.name: Heroic Games Launcher plugin for AKL

extension.summary: Heroic Games Launcher scanner, scraper and launcher plugin for AKL.
extension.description: Advanced Kodi Launcher (AKL) plugin for the Heroic Games Launcher on Linux. It scans your Heroic library (Epic Games, GOG, Amazon Prime Gaming and sideloaded games) directly from Heroic's local store cache, launches games through Heroic (Flatpak or native install) and scrapes titles, plots, developers and artwork from the data Heroic already keeps on disk. No credentials or API keys needed.
extension.news: Initial release: scan, launch and scrape Heroic games from AKL.
